name: EvidenceCheck
description: Evidence-first vendor due-diligence and website security preflight for procurement, third-party risk, security/compliance workflows and AI agents.

capabilities.description: Fast vendor-risk signal, observable checks, evidence gaps and verification questions.
Public website security preflight covering observable HTTPS, headers, cookies and disclosure signals.
Clean webpage text, metadata, headings and links for downstream agent workflows.
Structured business-document triage for dates, amounts, obligations, security signals, gaps and risk flags.

trust_boundary: Not a penetration test or vulnerability scanner.
Public signals are not proof of controls.
Material procurement and security decisions require human verification.
